onboarding.title: Set Up Your Device
onboarding.description: Follow these steps to connect your Android device for threat analysis.
onboarding.step1Desc: On your Android device, go to Settings → About Phone → tap Build Number 7 times to unlock Developer Options. Then go to Settings → Developer Options → enable USB Debugging.
onboarding.step1Detail: This allows Jerion to communicate with your device over USB via ADB.
onboarding.step2Desc: After connecting the USB cable, your device will show a dialog asking to allow USB debugging from this computer. Tap 'Always allow from this computer' and confirm.
onboarding.step2Detail: This grants Jerion persistent access so the prompt does not appear every session.
onboarding.skipHint: Already set up? Close this dialog and connect your device.
